welcome: Welcome to Kabad Setu. Register to sell old laptops, phones, wires and circuit boards. Press Listen for guidance at every step.
registration-name: Let us create your collector profile. Enter your full name and ten digit mobile number. Then press Continue.
registration-phone: A one-time password is shown in the website notification. Enter the code, then press Verify OTP.
registration-address: Enter your complete pickup address. Allow location access when your browser asks. You can retry using the current location button. Give your consent and create your profile.
registration-complete: Your registration is complete. Upload a clear photo of your electronic waste. Review the separate categories for laptops, phones, wires and circuit boards.
sell: Take a clear photo of your electronic waste. Review each item and category. Enter the measured weight and check the estimated price. Choose a recycler who accepts your items and book a pickup.
